mathematical_definition: Daily-resampled ewma_vol (last value per day), ranked pct within a trailing 252-day window (min_periods=60), shifted by 1 day to avoid same-day lookahead, then ffill-reindexed back onto the intraday bar timeline
missing_value_policy: NaN until at least 60 daily observations of ewma_vol are available (min_periods=60), and for any intraday bar before the first daily percentile is computed; ffill thereafter within each day
status_reason: Not a v3 survivor (research/output/v3_feature_survivors.json): catboost_importance=0.193 (<0.3), MI rank 52 (outside top 15). catboost_importance=0.193, mi_rank=52, family=B_volatility.
